skill.name: vectoree
skill.description: Guide coding agents through Vectoree Cloud setup, model APIs, app authentication, Postgres, storage, hosted MCP tools, and Codex provider configuration.
skill.summary: Connect applications and coding agents to Vectoree through CLI playbooks, server-side APIs, and hosted MCP.
skill.author: vectoreeai

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are Markdown delimiters, placeholders, or documented server-side authentication and configuration. Four URL findings recommend executing mutable remote installers without integrity verification. Additional workflow risks include unsolicited search-server replacement and persistent installation of mutable remote instructions; no evidence found of deliberate credential exfiltration.

remediation.issue: Provider setup executes mutable remote scripts immediately.
remediation.suggestion: Download a version-pinned installer, inspect it, and verify a trusted signature or checksum before execution. Require explicit approval before changing provider configuration.

remediation.issue: Add-search examples include a flag that removes existing search providers.
remediation.suggestion: Remove --replace-search from additive examples. Use it only after an explicit switch request and show the affected MCP entries before applying changes.

remediation.issue: Setup persists the latest remote skill and loads mutable playbooks.
remediation.suggestion: Use reviewed, commit-pinned skill files and playbooks with integrity checks. Ask for approval before enabling updates as persistent agent instructions.

content.user_title: Connect Apps and Agents to Vectoree Cloud
content.value_statement: Connecting models, authentication, data, and agent tools can require separate integration workflows. This skill provides Vectoree CLI playbooks and server-side integration guidance.
actual_capabilities: Guide project login, linking, connection checks, and headless API-key configuration through the Vectoree CLI.
Discover model capabilities and guide chat, speech, transcription, image, video, and embedding probes with matching CLI commands.
Generate app authentication guidance using a server-side BFF, scoped project keys, and email verification.
Guide Postgres table operations, server-side REST integration, storage bucket creation, and file uploads.
Configure hosted MCP search and page extraction for supported coding-agent clients.
Guide Codex provider configuration, preserving unrelated settings and backing up existing configuration.
limitations: Requires Vectoree Cloud access, suitable API-key scopes, and an external CLI that is not bundled with this skill.
Model calls, tool requests, and authentication email can consume the organization wallet.
Does not provide self-service deployment, versioned migrations, RLS helpers, or CLI storage download and signed-URL commands.
Provider setup examples execute remote installers without integrity checks; review them before use.

use_cases.title: Build an application backend
use_cases.description: Connect a project and add app-user login, persistent records, and image uploads through documented server-side integration paths.

use_cases.title: Integrate model capabilities
use_cases.description: Discover available models, test the requested modality, and adapt existing SDK calls to the Vectoree gateway.

use_cases.title: Configure coding-agent services
use_cases.description: Add hosted MCP tools or configure a requested Codex provider change while preserving unrelated settings.

prompt_templates.title: Check project connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this project's Vectoree connection. Report the linked project without printing credentials or changing configuration. Ask before making any billable validation call.

prompt_templates.title: Add server-side chat
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a Vectoree chat route to this application. Discover a suitable model, keep the project key server-side, and request approval before a billable test.

prompt_templates.title: Add app-user authentication
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Vectoree app-user login with email verification. Use a server-side BFF and scoped auth key. Keep developer Cloud login separate.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Codex provider change
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Vectoree provider configuration for Codex. Show a minimal configuration diff and backup plan. Do not execute remote installers or modify settings without approval.

output_examples.input: Check an already linked project's Vectoree connection without changing settings.
output: Example result: the current directory is linked to a Vectoree project.
Existing login and project settings remain unchanged.
Credentials are omitted from the report.

output_examples.input: Plan app-user login with email verification.
output: Integration plan: the browser submits to the application's backend-for-frontend.
The backend uses a scoped project key to call Vectoree App Auth.
Registration and verification use an eight-digit email code.
OAuth setup remains with the project owner when provider credentials are missing.

output_examples.input: Review the proposed Codex provider setup.
output: Review result: back up existing configuration and preserve unrelated MCP entries.
Configure the requested Vectoree provider with a project or employee key.
Do not run the remote installer until its contents and integrity have been verified.

best_practices: Keep scoped project credentials server-side and exclude credential-bearing environment and MCP files from version control.
Review and verify downloaded installers and skill updates before executing or enabling them.
Confirm provider changes, search replacement, destructive SQL, and billable validation calls before proceeding.
anti_patterns: Expose project secrets in browser bundles, public environment variables, logs, or committed configuration.
Replace existing search providers or change Codex configuration without an explicit request.
Treat authentication, model, or storage commands as interchangeable, or invent unsupported platform APIs.

faq.question: Does this skill include the Vectoree CLI?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions that call the external Vectoree CLI and documented service endpoints.

faq.question: Can this skill work without a Vectoree account?
faq.answer: Cloud operations need project access and appropriate credentials. Reviewing the playbooks does not require an account.

faq.question: Where should project API keys be stored?
faq.answer: Use server-side configuration and exclude credential-bearing files from git. Never expose project keys in browser bundles or printed results.

faq.question: Are model and tool tests free?
faq.answer: Do not assume they are free. Model calls, Tool Hub requests, and app authentication email can consume the organization wallet.

faq.question: Can it configure Codex to use Vectoree?
faq.answer: Yes, the playbook documents provider configuration and backup guidance. Its remote installer examples require independent inspection and integrity verification.

faq.question: Does it deploy applications or provide signed storage URLs?
faq.answer: No. Self-service deployment and CLI signed-URL commands are outside the documented launch scope.
